chapters.title: Early Turkish Invasions (Arab se Ghori tak)
chapters.blurb: Sindh par Arab attack se lekar Ghori ke India campaigns tak ki chain.

events.title: Muhammad bin Qasim ne Sindh jeeta
events.detail: Umayyad Khalifa ke governor Hajjaj ne bheja; Raja Dahir ko Rewar ki ladai me haraya. Yahi India me pehla successful Arab attack tha.
events.reason: Debal ke pass Arab merchant ships ko lootne aur Dahir dwara harjana dene se inkaar ki wajah se.

events.title: Mahmud Ghaznavi ka pehla India attack
events.detail: Mahmud ne 1000 se 1027 ke beech kul 17 baar India par attack kiya, par yaha raajya banane ki koshish nahi ki.
events.reason: Mandiron aur shehron ki daulat loot kar Ghazni empire ko funding dena.

events.title: Somnath Temple par attack
events.detail: Gujarat ke Somnath mandir ko loota — Mahmud ka sabse mashhoor aur sabse dhanwaan raid.
events.reason: Mandir me jama sona-chandi aur prestige.

events.title: Tarain ka pehla yuddh
events.detail: Prithviraj Chauhan III ne Muhammad Ghori ko haraya — Ghori zakhmi hokar bhaga.
events.reason: Ghori Punjab-Delhi route par kabza chahta tha; Bhatinda fort par jhagda hua.

events.title: Tarain ka doosra yuddh
events.detail: Ghori ne Prithviraj ko haraya — North India me Turkish rule ki neev pad gayi.
events.reason: Ghori ne badla lene aur Ganga valley kholne ke liye dobara badi cavalry se attack kiya.

events.title: Chandawar ka yuddh
events.detail: Kannauj ke Gahadavala raja Jaichand ko haraya — Ganga doab Turks ke haath aaya.
events.reason: Ganga valley ke sabse taakatwar Rajput power ko khatam karna.

events.title: Ghori ki hatya, Qutubuddin Aibak sultan bana
events.detail: Ghori ki maut ke baad uska ghulam-general Aibak Lahore me gaddi par baitha — Delhi Sultanate shuru.
events.reason: Ghori ka koi beta nahi tha, isliye uske ghulam generals ne satta baanti.

chapters.title: Slave / Mamluk Dynasty (1206–1290)
chapters.blurb: Aibak se Balban tak — kaun aaya, kisko hata ke aaya.

events.title: Qutubuddin Aibak gaddi par
events.detail: Lakh Baksh kehlaye; Qutub Minar ki neev aur Quwwat-ul-Islam masjid banwayi. Lahore me chaugan (polo) khelte hue ghode se girkar maut.
events.reason: Ghori ka viceroy hone ke naate satta uske haath aayi.

events.title: Aram Shah ka chhota shasan
events.detail: Aibak ke baad aaya par nakaabil tha; Delhi ke amiron ne Iltutmish ko bula liya aur Aram Shah maara gaya.

events.title: Iltutmish sultan bana
events.detail: Aram Shah ko hara kar aaya. Sultanate ka asli sansthapak — Delhi ko capital banaya, Iqta system aur Chalisa (Turkan-i-Chahalgani) banaya, Silver Tanka & Copper Jital chalaya.
events.reason: Aibak ka damad aur sabse taakatwar governor hone ki wajah se amiron ne use chuna.

events.title: Chengiz Khan Indus tak aaya
events.detail: Iltutmish ne Khwarizm ke shahzade Jalaluddin Mangbarni ko sharan dene se mana kiya — isi diplomacy se Mongol invasion tal gaya.
events.reason: Mongols Mangbarni ka peecha karte hue Indus tak pahunche the.

events.title: Razia Sultan gaddi par
events.detail: Delhi ki pehli aur akeli mahila shasak. Bhai Ruknuddin Firoz ko hata kar aayi; Yakut ko amir-i-akhur banane par Turkish amiron ne bagawat ki aur 1240 me maar diya.
events.reason: Iltutmish ne khud use uttaradhikari chuna tha.

events.title: Nasiruddin Mahmud aur Balban ki shakti
events.detail: Naam ka sultan; asli taakat uske naib Balban ke paas thi jo Quran ki nakal likh kar guzara karne ki kahani se mashhoor hai.

events.title: Balban sultan bana
events.detail: Chalisa ko khatam kiya, Sijda & Paibos, Nauroz festival, 'Zil-i-Ilahi' (God's shadow) theory, alag Diwan-i-Arz (military dept) banaya — Blood & Iron policy.
events.reason: Nasiruddin ki maut ke baad naib se seedha sultan ban gaya.

events.title: Jalaluddin Khilji — Slave dynasty ka ant
events.detail: Balban ke poti-pote nakaabil nikle; Kaiqubad/Kayumars ko hata kar Jalaluddin Khilji ne Khilji vansh shuru kiya.

chapters.title: Khilji Dynasty (1290–1320)
chapters.blurb: Alauddin ke market control, Deccan campaigns aur Mongol defence.

events.title: Jalaluddin Firoz Khilji
events.detail: Narm dil shasak; apne bhatije-damad Alauddin dwara dhokhe se maara gaya.

events.title: Devagiri raid aur Alauddin ka takht
events.detail: Devagiri (Ramachandra Yadava) se lootI daulat se sena khadi ki, Kara me Jalaluddin ki hatya karke sultan bana.
events.reason: Deccan ki daulat aur takht ki lalach.

events.title: Ranthambore vijay
events.detail: Hammiradeva ko hara kar Ranthambore jeeta — pehla bada Rajput fort.
events.reason: Ranthambore ne Alauddin ke Mongol vidrohiyon ko sharan di thi.

events.title: Chittor vijay
events.detail: Rana Ratan Singh ko hara kar Chittor jeeta; Padmavat (Jayasi, 1540) me isi ki kahani hai.
events.reason: Mewar ki strategic taakat todna.

events.title: Market / Price Control policy
events.detail: Diwan-i-Riyasat, Shahna-i-Mandi, Barid & Munhiyan spies; anaj, kapda, ghode sab ke rate fix. Dagh (ghode par nishan) aur Chehra (soldier ka huliya) system laaya.
events.reason: Kam salary me badi sthaayi sena rakhni thi taaki Mongol attack roka ja sake.

events.title: Malik Kafur ka Deccan abhiyan shuru
events.detail: Devagiri, Warangal (Kakatiya), Dwarasamudra (Hoysala) aur Madurai (Pandya) — sabse tribute vasoola.
events.reason: Deccan ko jeetne ki jagah paisa aur wafadari lena.

events.title: Alauddin ki maut, ashanti
events.detail: Kafur ne satta hathiyai par jaldi maara gaya; Mubarak Shah Khilji aaya.

events.title: Khusrau Khan aur Khilji vansh ka ant
events.detail: Mubarak Shah ko Khusrau Khan ne maara; phir Ghazi Malik (Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq) ne Khusrau ko hara kar Tughlaq vansh shuru kiya.

chapters.title: Tughlaq Dynasty (1320–1414)
chapters.blurb: Muhammad bin Tughlaq ke experiments aur Firoz ki welfare policies.

events.title: Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq
events.detail: Tughlaqabad basaya; Afghanpur me lakdi ke pandal girne se maut (Ibn Battuta ke anusaar shak beta Juna Khan par).

events.title: Muhammad bin Tughlaq gaddi par
events.detail: Sabse padha-likha par 'ill-starred idealist'. Ibn Battuta ko Qazi banaya.

events.title: Capital transfer: Delhi → Daulatabad
events.detail: Poori aabadi ko Devagiri (Daulatabad) le gaya, 2 saal baad wapas laaya — bada failure.
events.reason: Deccan par control aur Mongol attacks se capital ko surakshit rakhna.

events.title: Token currency
events.detail: Bronze/copper token coins ko silver value par chalaya; nakli sikkon ki baadh aa gayi aur wapas lena pada.
events.reason: Silver ki kami aur khaali khazana.

events.title: Doab me tax badhotri aur akaal
events.detail: Ganga-Yamuna doab me kar badhaya jab akaal pada — kisan bhaag gaye; baad me Diwan-i-Kohi (agriculture dept) banaya.
events.reason: Khazane ki bharpai.

events.title: Vijayanagara ki sthapna
events.detail: Sangama vansh — Hampi (Tungabhadra) rajdhani; Tughlaq kamzori ka faayda.

events.title: Bahmani Kingdom ki sthapna
events.detail: Hasan Gangu ne Gulbarga me Bahmani rajya banaya (baad me Bidar).

events.title: Firoz Shah Tughlaq
events.detail: Sirf 4 kar (Kharaj, Zakat, Jizya, Khams), Diwan-i-Khairat, Diwan-i-Bandagan, nahron ka nirman, Hisar-Firozabad-Jaunpur-Fatehabad shehar basaye; Sultanate me pehli baar Brahmins par bhi Jizya.
events.reason: Ulema aur nobility ko khush rakh kar sthirta laana.

events.title: Timur ka Delhi par attack
events.detail: Nasiruddin Mahmud Tughlaq ke samay Timur ne Delhi ko loota aur qatl-e-aam kiya; Khizr Khan ko Multan ka governor chhod gaya.
events.reason: Delhi ki kamzori aur daulat.

events.title: Sayyid vansh shuru
events.detail: Khizr Khan ne Daulat Khan Lodi ko hata kar Sayyid vansh chalaya (1414–1451).

chapters.title: Lodi Dynasty & Sur Empire
chapters.blurb: Bahlol se Ibrahim Lodi, phir Sher Shah ke reforms.

events.title: Bahlol Lodi
events.detail: Pehla Afghan shasak; Jaunpur ke Sharqi rajya ko mila liya.

events.title: Sikandar Lodi
events.detail: Agra shehar basaya (1504) aur capital banaya; Gaz-i-Sikandari (measurement scale); 'Gulrukhi' naam se shayari.

events.title: Ibrahim Lodi
events.detail: Afghan sardaron se takraav; chacha Daulat Khan Lodi aur Rana Sanga ne Babur ko bulaya.

events.title: Panipat ka pehla yuddh
events.detail: Babur ne Ibrahim Lodi ko haraya — Tulughma & Araba (cannon) tactics; Mughal rule shuru.
events.reason: Daulat Khan Lodi aur Alam Khan ne Babur ko invite kiya; Babur Timur ki virasat par daava karta tha.

events.title: Chausa ka yuddh
events.detail: Sher Shah ne Humayun ko haraya; 'Sher Shah' title liya.
events.reason: Bengal-Bihar par control ke liye Humayun se takraav.

events.title: Kannauj (Bilgram) ka yuddh — Sur empire
events.detail: Humayun bhaga (15 saal nirvasan); Sher Shah Delhi ka shasak bana.

events.title: Sher Shah ke reforms
events.detail: Rupiya (silver) aur Dam (copper), Zabti/Ryotwari revenue with Patta-Qabuliyat, Grand Trunk Road (Sadak-e-Azam), sarai + dak chowki, Purana Qila aur Sasaram ka maqbara.
events.reason: Kisan se seedha, naapa hua lagaan lekar prashasan majboot karna.

events.title: Kalinjar me Sher Shah ki maut
events.detail: Kalinjar fort par barood phatne se maut; beta Islam Shah aaya.

events.title: Humayun ki wapsi
events.detail: Machhiwara aur Sirhind jeet kar Delhi wapas liya; 1556 me Sher Mandal seedhiyon se girkar maut.

chapters.title: Mughal Empire (1526–1707)
chapters.blurb: Babur se Aurangzeb — wars, policies aur unke naam.

events.title: Khanwa ka yuddh
events.detail: Rana Sanga (Mewar) ko haraya; Babur ne 'Ghazi' title liya aur Tamgha tax hataya.
events.reason: Rana Sanga North India par khud kabza chahta tha aur Babur ke rukne se naraz tha.

events.title: Ghaghra ka yuddh
events.detail: Bihar-Bengal ke Afghans ko haraya — Babur ki aakhri badi jeet.
events.reason: Mahmud Lodi ke netritva me Afghan sangathan ko khatam karna.

events.title: Panipat ka doosra yuddh, Akbar gaddi par
events.detail: Bairam Khan ke netritva me Hemu ko haraya; Akbar 13 saal ki umar me sultan.
events.reason: Hemu ne Delhi-Agra par kabza kar liya tha aur 'Vikramaditya' title liya tha.

events.title: Akbar ki udaar policies shuru
events.detail: 1562 me daas pratha aur teerth yatra kar khatam, 1564 me Jizya khatam, Rajput vivah-sandhi.
events.reason: Rajputon aur bahusankhyak praja ka sahyog lekar samrajya sthir karna.

events.title: Fatehpur Sikri aur Ibadat Khana
events.detail: 1575 me Ibadat Khana me dharmik bahas; 1582 me Din-i-Ilahi (Tauhid-i-Ilahi); Sulh-i-Kul ka siddhant.

events.title: Haldighati ka yuddh
events.detail: Man Singh ke netritva me Mughal sena vs Maharana Pratap — Pratap ne haar ke baad bhi guerrilla ladai jaari rakhi.
events.reason: Pratap ne Akbar ki adhinta maanne se inkaar kiya.

events.title: Mansabdari & Dahsala system
events.detail: Zat (rank) aur Sawar (cavalry) ka Mansabdari; Raja Todarmal ka Dahsala/Zabti — 10 saal ke ausat daam par lagaan.
events.reason: Sena aur revenue ko ek standard, kendrit dhanche me laana.

events.title: Jahangir
events.detail: Zanjir-i-Adl (chain of justice), 12 ordinances; Nur Jahan junta; Captain Hawkins (1608) aur Sir Thomas Roe (1615) aaye.

events.title: Shah Jahan
events.detail: Golden age of architecture — Taj Mahal (1632–53), Red Fort, Jama Masjid, Peacock Throne; 1658 me Aurangzeb ne band kar diya.

events.title: Samugarh ka yuddh, Aurangzeb ka takht
events.detail: Dara Shikoh ko hara kar Aurangzeb 'Alamgir' bana.
events.reason: Shah Jahan ki bimari ke baad uttaradhikar ka yuddh.

events.title: Jizya dobara lagaya
events.detail: Jizya wapas, sangeet-darbar par rok, mandir todne ki policy — Rajput, Jat, Sikh aur Maratha vidroh bhadke.
events.reason: Orthodox Islamic shasan ka model apnana.

events.title: Shivaji ka rajyabhishek
events.detail: Raigad me Chhatrapati; Ashta Pradhan mandal, Chauth & Sardeshmukhi vasooli.
events.reason: Swaraj ko vaidhta dena.

events.title: Aurangzeb ki maut — patan shuru
events.detail: Deccan ke lambe yuddh (1681–1707) ne khazana khaali kar diya; Mughal empire bikharne laga.

chapters.title: Arrival of Europeans & Company Rule
chapters.blurb: Portuguese se lekar Plassey-Buxar tak ka chain.

events.title: Vasco da Gama Calicut pahuncha
events.detail: Zamorin ke darbar me; Cape of Good Hope route se sea-route khula.
events.reason: Masalon (spices) ka seedha vyapar marg dhoondhna.

events.title: English East India Company ka charter
events.detail: 31 Dec 1600 ko 15 saal ke monopoly charter ke saath company bani.

events.title: Dutch East India Company (VOC)
events.detail: Pulicat, Nagapattinam; 1759 Bedara ki ladai me Dutch haar gaye.

events.title: French East India Company
events.detail: Louis XIV ke mantri Colbert ne banayi; Pondicherry aur Chandernagore centres.

events.title: Plassey ka yuddh
events.detail: Siraj-ud-Daulah ko haraya; Mir Jafar ki gaddari; Bengal me Company ka political rule shuru.
events.reason: Dastak ka durupyog, Company ki fort-building aur Nawab ki naraazgi.

events.title: Buxar ka yuddh
events.detail: Mir Qasim + Shuja-ud-Daulah + Shah Alam II ki sanyukt sena haari — Company ki military supremacy pakki.
events.reason: Mir Qasim ne duty-free trade khatam kar diya tha.

events.title: Diwani aur Dual Government
events.detail: Allahabad sandhi se Bengal-Bihar-Odisha ki Diwani mili; revenue Company ke paas, prashasan Nawab ke paas — 1770 ka Bengal akaal isi ka nateeja.
events.reason: Bina zimmedari ke revenue par kabza.

events.title: Regulating Act
events.detail: Bengal ka Governor-General banaya, Calcutta Supreme Court; Company par British sansad ka pehla control.

events.title: Pitt's India Act
events.detail: Board of Control — dohra niyantran (Company + Crown).

chapters.title: Governor-Generals & Unke Policies
chapters.blurb: Har GG/Viceroy ki signature policy aur uska naam.

events.title: Permanent Settlement
events.detail: Zamindar ko maalik maana, lagaan hamesha ke liye fix; police & civil services ka europeanisation ('Father of Civil Services').
events.reason: Sthir revenue aur wafadar zamindar class banana.

events.title: Subsidiary Alliance
events.detail: Hyderabad (1798) sabse pehle; desi raja British sena rakhe, uska kharcha de, videshi sambandh chhod de.
events.reason: Bina yuddh ke desi rajyon ko control me lena aur French prabhav khatam karna.

events.title: Ryotwari & Mahalwari
events.detail: Ryotwari (Madras-Bombay) me kisan seedha state ko de; Mahalwari (NW Provinces, 1822) me poora gaon/mahal zimmedar.
events.reason: Permanent Settlement ke revenue nuksan se bachna.

events.title: Sati Pratha ka ant
events.detail: Regulation XVII se Sati gair-kanooni; Raja Rammohan Roy ka samarthan; 1835 me Macaulay Minute se English shiksha.
events.reason: Samaj sudharakon ka dabav aur humanitarian reform.

events.title: Doctrine of Lapse
events.detail: Satara(1848), Jhansi(1853), Nagpur(1854); Awadh 1856 me kushasan ke naam par; railway (1853), telegraph, PWD, Wood's Despatch (1854).
events.reason: God liye putra ko uttaradhikari na maankar rajya hadapna.

events.title: Royal Titles Act & Delhi Durbar
events.detail: Victoria 'Kaiser-i-Hind'; Vernacular Press Act (1878), Arms Act (1878), ICS umar 21→19.
events.reason: Imperial prestige aur Indian criticism dabana.

events.title: Local Self Government
events.detail: 'Father of Local Self Government'; Vernacular Press Act hataya, Ilbert Bill (1883), Hunter Commission (1882).

events.title: Bengal ka Vibhajan
events.detail: 16 Oct 1905 se laagu; Swadeshi & Boycott andolan bhadka; 1911 me rad.
events.reason: Prashasnik suvidha ke naam par Hindu-Muslim aur Bengali ekta todna.

events.title: Rowlatt Act & Jallianwala Bagh
events.detail: Bina mukadme jail; 13 April 1919 Amritsar me Dyer ne firing ki; Hunter Commission; Tagore ne Knighthood lautaya.

events.title: Mountbatten Plan
events.detail: 3 June 1947 plan; Indian Independence Act (18 July 1947); 15 Aug 1947 azadi + vibhajan; Radcliffe Line.

events.title: Mangal Pandey ka vidroh (29 March)
events.detail: Barrackpore me 34th NI ke sipahi; 8 April ko phansi.
events.reason: Enfield rifle ke cartridges me gaay-suar ki charbi ki afwah.

events.title: Meerut se shuruaat (10 May)
events.detail: Sipahi Delhi pahunche aur Bahadur Shah Zafar ko netritva saunpa.

events.title: Kanpur — Nana Saheb
events.detail: Tatya Tope commander; British officer Hugh Wheeler/Campbell.
events.reason: Peshwa Baji Rao II ki pension band kar di gayi thi.

events.title: Lucknow — Begum Hazrat Mahal
events.detail: Henry Lawrence ki maut; Colin Campbell ne 1858 me dabaya.
events.reason: Awadh ka 1856 ka annexation.

events.title: Jhansi & Gwalior — Rani Lakshmibai
events.detail: Hugh Rose ke khilaf ladi; 17 June 1858 ko Gwalior me shahadat.
events.reason: Doctrine of Lapse se Jhansi ka annexation.

events.title: Queen's Proclamation / GoI Act 1858
events.detail: Company rule khatam, Crown ka seedha shasan; Secretary of State for India + 15-member council; Canning pehla Viceroy.
events.reason: Vidroh ke baad prashasan ko badalna.

chapters.title: INC, Moderates & Extremists
chapters.blurb: 1885 se 1916 tak — Surat Split se Lucknow Pact.

events.title: Indian National Congress ki sthapna
events.detail: Bombay, Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College; pehle adhyaksh W.C. Bonnerjee; 72 delegates.

events.title: Swadeshi & Boycott Movement
events.detail: Bengal vibhajan ke virodh me; Rabindranath ka 'Amar Sonar Bangla'; Rakhi bandhan protest.

events.title: Muslim League ki sthapna
events.detail: Dhaka me; Calcutta session (Dadabhai Naoroji) me Congress ne 'Swaraj' ko lakshya kaha.

events.title: Surat Split
events.detail: Congress Garam dal (Lal-Bal-Pal) aur Naram dal me toot gayi.
events.reason: Adhyaksh chunav aur Swadeshi-Boycott ki gati par matbhed.

events.title: Morley-Minto Reforms
events.detail: Muslims ke liye alag nirvachan mandal (separate electorate) — communal politics ki neev.
events.reason: Muslim League ko sath rakh kar Congress ko kamzor karna.

events.title: Lucknow Pact & Home Rule
events.detail: Congress-League samjhauta; Tilak (April, Pune) aur Annie Besant (Sept, Madras) ke Home Rule leagues.

chapters.title: Gandhian Era (1917–1942)
chapters.blurb: Champaran se Quit India tak movement chain.

events.title: Champaran Satyagraha
events.detail: India me Gandhi ka pehla civil disobedience; Rajkumar Shukla ne bulaya.
events.reason: Tinkathia system — neel (indigo) ki jabran kheti.

events.title: Kheda & Ahmedabad
events.detail: Kheda me pehla non-cooperation (tax na dena), Ahmedabad mill me pehla bhookh hartal.
events.reason: Fasal kharab hone par bhi lagaan maafi na milna; mazdooron ka plague bonus.

events.title: Non-Cooperation + Khilafat
events.detail: Nagpur session; titles wapas, school-court-videshi maal ka boycott; 1922 Chauri Chaura ke baad wapas.
events.reason: Rowlatt Act, Jallianwala Bagh aur Khilafat ka mudda.

events.title: Simon Commission & Nehru Report
events.detail: 'Simon Go Back'; Lahore me lathi charge se Lajpat Rai ki maut; Motilal Nehru Report me Dominion Status.
events.reason: Commission me ek bhi Indian sadasya nahi tha.

events.title: Dandi March & Civil Disobedience
events.detail: 12 March–6 April, Sabarmati se Dandi 385 km; namak kanoon toda; 1930 First Round Table.
events.reason: Namak par sarkari monopoly — har garib ko chhoone wala mudda.

events.title: Communal Award & Poona Pact
events.detail: Depressed classes ko separate electorate; Gandhi ke anshan ke baad Ambedkar-Gandhi Poona Pact (reserved seats within joint electorate).

events.title: Government of India Act 1935
events.detail: Provincial autonomy, federation ka dhancha, RBI aur Federal Court (1937); Indian Constitution ka bada source.

events.title: Quit India Movement
events.detail: 8 Aug 1942 Bombay AICC; 'Do or Die'; Aruna Asaf Ali ne tiranga fehraya; leaderless mass revolt.
events.reason: Cripps Mission ki vifalta aur Japan ke khatre ke beech turant azadi ki maang.

chapters.title: Revolutionary Movement & INA
chapters.blurb: Crank of bombs — Alipore se Red Fort trials tak.

events.title: Muzaffarpur Bomb Case
events.detail: Kingsford ko maarne ki koshish; Khudiram ko 1908 me phansi.
events.reason: Judge Kingsford ke kathor faislon ka badla.

events.title: Ghadar Party
events.detail: San Francisco me; 'Ghadar' akhbar; 1915 ki Ghadar sazish vifal.

events.title: Kakori Train Action
events.detail: HRA dwara sarkari khazana loota; 1927 me phansi.
events.reason: Krantikari sangathan ke liye hathiyar khareedne ka paisa.

events.title: HSRA aur Saunders vadh
events.detail: Chandrashekhar Azad ke saath HSRA; Saunders ko maara.
events.reason: Lala Lajpat Rai par lathi charge ka badla.

events.title: Central Assembly Bomb
events.detail: 8 April 1929, 'Inquilab Zindabad'; 23 March 1931 ko Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, Rajguru ko phansi.
events.reason: Public Safety Bill & Trade Disputes Bill ka virodh — 'bahron ko sunane ke liye'.

events.title: Azad Hind Fauj (INA)
events.detail: Singapore me Provisional Government; Rani Jhansi Regiment; 1945–46 Red Fort trials ne desh me lehar failayi.
events.reason: Sashastra sangharsh se azadi lena.

events.title: RIN Mutiny
events.detail: 18 Feb 1946 Bombay; British ko lagne laga ki armed forces par bharosa nahi raha.
events.reason: Nasleey bhedbhav, kharab khana aur INA trials.

chapters.title: Towards Independence (1942–1950)
chapters.blurb: Cripps se Constitution tak final chain.

events.title: Cripps Mission
events.detail: Dominion status ka vaada — Gandhi ne 'post-dated cheque' kaha.
events.reason: World War me Indian sahyog chahiye tha.

events.title: Wavell Plan & Shimla Conference
events.detail: Executive Council me Indian bahumat ka prastav; Jinnah ki zid se vifal.

events.title: Cabinet Mission
events.detail: Grouping plan + Constituent Assembly ka chunav; 16 Aug 1946 Direct Action Day.

events.title: Constituent Assembly ki pehli baithak
events.detail: 9 Dec 1946 asthayi adhyaksh; 11 Dec ko Rajendra Prasad sthayi adhyaksh; 13 Dec Objective Resolution (Nehru).

events.title: Indian Independence Act
events.detail: 18 July 1947 ko royal assent; 15 Aug 1947 ko do dominions.

events.title: Samvidhan adopt
events.detail: 26 Nov 1949 ko apnaya gaya (kuch provisions usi din laagu).

events.title: Samvidhan laagu
events.detail: 26 Jan 1950 — 1930 ke Purna Swaraj diwas ki yaad me.
